lines.zh: 这条路我数着走了三遍。
lines.en: I've counted this path three times over.
I step along the gap beneath the door.
My steps never touch the floor.
The black on the wall shifts with me.
I move inward along the base of the wall.

lines.zh: 我踩过的地方温度变了。
lines.en: The places I tread grow colder.

lines.zh: 我没有影子，我就是影子。
lines.en: I cast no shadow. I am the shadow.
Whispers — just wind through grass.
My print is in the dust you crossed.

lines.zh: 木板被压下去，没有声音。
lines.en: The boards bend without a sound.
I pass through the door without a sound.
The seventh stair has a crack in it.
A shadow takes no room — ignore me.
You have a mole under your right eye.
The edges of my outline are fraying.
One touch of light thins me by half.
The clock on the wall has stopped at three.
Someone is dragging a crate in the attic.
The light behind the curtain has dimmed.

lines.zh: 我没有刷怪蛋，只有影子。
lines.en: I have no spawn egg, only a shadow.
I try to copy the way you breathe in.
This family sleeps very deeply.
The doorknob hasn't turned once.

lines.zh: 灯灭了又亮，我挪了一寸。
lines.en: The lamp goes out and on; I shifted an inch.

lines.zh: 我连自己的边都摸不到。
lines.en: I cannot even find my own edges.
Even the rats won't come out.
Half a step is all that separates us.
A shadow has no face; you can't make it out.
I have no face, only blackness.
There's a draft where you're standing.
I haven't forgotten that gasp.

lines.zh: 你眼睛里的我越来越近。
lines.en: The me in your eyes draws closer.

lines.zh: 灯灭的时候，我就到你身边。
lines.en: When the lamp goes out, I'm beside you.
Your torchlight can't pass through me.

lines.zh: 你身后的墙角，我站了很久。
lines.en: I've stood in that corner a while.
I see you, Shadow.
There's no shadow on the back of your neck.
The torch you're holding is about to drop.
A shadow has no face — you can't see it clearly

lines.zh: 你昨天也站在这块砖上。
lines.en: You stood on this same brick yesterday.
Your breath skipped a beat.

lines.zh: 你看我的时候我不眨眼。
lines.en: I don't blink while you look at me.

lines.zh: 你眼白里的血丝很清楚。
lines.en: The red veins in your eyes are very clear.
There's a me inside your pupils.
You raised the lamp a little.

lines.zh: 你的肩膀绷得像块木头。
lines.en: Your shoulders are stiff as planks.
You hurt me.

lines.zh: 被驯服的那一个，不是我。
lines.en: The tamed one isn't me.
The blood is warm, I did not expect that.
Pain is something I'm not used to.
A shadow takes more than it looks like it can.
Even a torn shadow aches.

lines.zh: 影子也疼，只是你看不见。
lines.en: Shadows hurt too. You just can't see it.
Even a shadow can hurt.
A piece of my outline is missing.
Your fist sinks into the dark.
Lower the lamp so I can see.
You hold it out in front of you.
Your fingers are warmer than mine.

lines.zh: 那件东西上有你的味道。
lines.en: That thing carries your scent.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西在冒热气。
lines.en: The thing in your hand is steaming.
That petal is one I placed there.
I'll trade you a button for it.
It swallowed the light.

lines.zh: 树影浓的地方，我才成形。
lines.en: I only take shape in deep tree shade.

lines.zh: 我连自己的形状都抓不住。
lines.en: I cannot even hold my own shape.
Two shadows have overlapped.
A shadow shouldn't cast a shadow.

lines.zh: 我的形状，是照着你来的。
lines.en: My shape was copied from yours.

lines.zh: 墙里出来，身上没有温度。
lines.en: Out of the wall, with no warmth on me.

lines.zh: 贴着你的影子，我不出声。
lines.en: Against your shadow, I make no sound.
You struck me and I scattered a moment.
I passed through you, then pulled back.
You stepped into my dark.

lines.zh: 你整个人从我这穿过去。
lines.en: You passed right through me.

lines.zh: 我退后了，你也退一步吧。
lines.en: I stepped back; you should step back too.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸就是我的节拍。
lines.en: Your breathing is my beat.

lines.zh: 我不需要心跳，也能跟你走
lines.en: I don't need a heartbeat to follow you
In the dark, nobody needs a name.
That one step back was very light.
It takes two shadows to be warm.
In the dark I've practiced too many times.
Do not be afraid, I only come closer.
When I speak, the lights dim.
Your shadow is already pressed to mine.
Come with me, don't ask where.
Someone dropped it. I'll keep it for you.
All seven are in my palm.

lines.zh: 我把东西放回原处，没人知。
lines.en: I put it back, and no one knows.

lines.zh: 这枚钥匙是从你门上来。
lines.en: This key came off your own door.
This petal's shadow is paler than mine.

lines.zh: 我没有实体，只能贴着你走。
lines.en: I have no body; I can only walk beside you.
There's no warmth on this thing.

lines.zh: 这块东西，我拿一件就够。
lines.en: One piece is all I take.
There's a little cloth bundle under the stairs.
This — you dropped it, right?
Every door has closed.
The footprints stop right here.
This is the moment. Hold still.
No turns left in this corridor.
Two damp marks are left on the carpet.
Don't stop, I'm not done playing.

lines.zh: 月光照不到你站的地方。
lines.en: Moonlight doesn't reach where you stand.

lines.zh: 我对着你的背呼了口气。
lines.en: I breathe out against your back.
You looked back. Too late.

lines.zh: 别回头。我的影子叠着你。
lines.en: Do not turn. My shadow overlaps yours.

lines.zh: 你呼吸的节奏，我听得出。
lines.en: I can hear the rhythm of your breathing.

lines.zh: 这个屋子里只有你一个。
lines.en: You're the only one in this house.

lines.zh: 你的影子出卖了你的位置。
lines.en: Your shadow gave away your spot.
Only dust under the bed.
Your pulse carries through the wall.
I remember the sound of your steps.
A door bolt won't stop a shadow.
That wall ahead of you is me.

lines.zh: 这条走廊我走了几十年。
lines.en: I've walked this corridor for decades.
I'll follow; the pace is mine.
I cling to the shade at the corner.
You've stopped at the stair landing.
Your footsteps are panicking.
You went toward the cupboard on the right.

lines.zh: 这栋屋子只有一个出口。
lines.en: This house has only one way out.
One wall away, I'm listening.
Your shadow stops before you do.
You can't hold your breath for long.
Stop a moment. Let's talk.
Your soles scrape along the floorboards.
Turn the lamp on and I fade.

lines.zh: 柜门的缝里透出你的气。
lines.en: Your breath leaks through the cabinet seam.
Your shadow keeps shrinking.

lines.zh: 没有生成记录，我也还在你后面。
lines.en: Unspawned, and still behind you.

lines.zh: 一次不够，那就多来几次。
lines.en: Once isn't enough, so it happens again.
Hold still, I haven't seen enough.

lines.zh: 我的手已经贴上你后颈。
lines.en: My hand is already on the back of your neck.

lines.zh: 这一碰，把你我的边都糊了。
lines.en: That touch smeared the edges of us both.
My hand reached out first. Instinct.
With your shadow pinned, you slow.
Don't speak. Don't turn.

lines.zh: 我的声音是从墙里出来的。
lines.en: My voice comes from inside the wall.
Scream. It's me you'll bring.

lines.zh: 我贴在你背后，一直贴着
lines.en: I'm right behind you, and I stay there
My shadow pins you down first.
Don't shout. The walls carry sound.
My fingers are cold. Don't tremble.
I have no hands. How would I stop?
The whisper is right behind your ear.
I cast no shadow — don't look.
I crouch at the head of your bed.
The corner of the room went cold first.
I settle in behind the door.
The lights went out in this house.
The number plate on this door has changed.
The bulb flickers twice and dies.
Someone in this house was just hurt.
woods. Back again.

lines.zh: 草地上的那片黑影，是我挪的。
lines.en: That dark patch on the grass is me.
The curtains are drawn tight.

lines.zh: 我贴着地面，比影子还薄。
lines.en: Flat to the ground, thinner than a shadow.
I squeeze in through the corner of the wall.
The lamp is lit; I should go where it is dark.
The floorboards are still these same boards.
A shadow needs no name.

lines.zh: 我贴在你脚边，你看不见。
lines.en: I cling to your feet, unseen.

lines.zh: 有人在这片暗影里走动。
lines.en: Someone moves in this shadow.
I come down along the ceiling.
Firelight reveals my shape.
I fall from the ceiling to the floor.

lines.zh: 水下的声音，比岸上清楚。
lines.en: Underwater sounds are clearer than on land.
One flash and I nearly scattered.
The arrowhead comes out through my body.
Your light pushed me back half a step.
I don't eat food; I eat shadows.
Thunder falls; I shrink into the dark.
There isn't even a shadow here.
